mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary_trash (user_id, diary_id, emotion, emotion_label, title, content, images, is_public, original_create_time, deleted_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{diaryId}, #{emotion}, #{emotionLabel}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images}, #{isPublic}, #{originalCreateTime}, NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY))
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, diary_id, emotion, emotion_label, title, content, images, is_public, original_create_time, deleted_time, expire_time FROM diary_trash WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expire_time > NOW() ORDER BY deleted_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM diary_trash WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM diary_trash WHERE expire_time <= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diary_trash WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expire_time > NOW()
